What's New
V6.2.1
Perfect Hero — Marvel
Direct slot placement + Marvel image repairs
  • Perfect Hero placement is now handled directly from the five slots — tap or click Strength, Speed, Durability, Intelligence or Powers to lock the current character in.
  • The separate placement-button row has been removed, making the mode faster and cleaner on both mobile and PC.
  • Every placement remains permanent: no respins, no swapping, no undo and no hints.
  • Repaired Nebula with a dedicated full-character Marvel portrait.
  • Repaired Shang-Chi with a dedicated full-character Marvel portrait.
  • All Perfect Hero rankings, roster, stats and core gameplay remain unchanged.
Major releases use x.0.0 and follow-up fixes use x.y.z so the release history stays clear and consistent.

You do not choose the hero. You only choose where they go.
How to play: Choose your universe filter before your first spin; once you spin, that choice is locked for the build. Spin to reveal a random hero, then choose exactly ONE open category. You have one Universe Respin and one Character Respin. Ratings stay hidden until after placement. After each placement, the game reveals the best available category you could have chosen. Weakness is vulnerability: lower is better. A hero can only be used once.
